title: Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish made with chicken, kissed olives, and french herbs.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the thyme, salt, and pepper, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the kissed olives and tagine spice blend.
Serve hot, garnished with french parsley.
Cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
